Home Secretary Shabana Mahmood diluted her original plans to make migrant care workers wait 15 years for settlement after criticism from senior Labour figures including Angela Rayner. Foreign care workers who earn at least £25,000 a year will now have to wait five years for permanent settlement in the UK.
Shadow Home Secretary Chris Philp described Shabana Mahmood's announcement as "a U-turn" and claimed it will cost the taxpayer £10 billion.
Reform UK leader Nigel Farage branded Mahmood's decision to water down plans for longer foreign worker settlement routes into the UK "the beginning of the capitulation".
